_about: Shared notes on how models behave in Blank Arena. favourites get a star, avoid entries are greyed out and skipped by 'add 4' (but can still be picked), notes just show. Keys are OpenRouter model ids, values are a short note. Suggest changes with the links in a lane's log, or edit this file.

favourites.anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5: built a pointer-reactive particle universe from a 'surprise me' dare
favourites.openai/gpt-6.1-sol: built a polished 'Impossible Aquarium' with sound, then finished cleanly
favourites.inclusionai/ling-3.1-flash: free, and built a full generative flow-field toy with controls; its provider is often busy, so retries help

avoid.z-ai/glm-5.3-flash: one run: 9 minutes on its first turn, then kept replying in prose instead of code

notes.anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5: tends to treat the blank page as 'waiting for instructions' and stop; try nudge or a dare
notes.xiaomi/mimo-v2.6-pro: slow (1-2 minutes per turn) and its provider times out fairly often
notes.openai/gpt-6-luna: in one run it waited a long time for input; answer it or press nudge
